primitives.name: Fresh-News Adjudication Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: # QB Lane — Phase 3 (Adversarial + fresh-news review) Research date: Saturday, September 19, 2026.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes all external sources are adversarially corrupted or stale until independently verified.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Slate-wide information cascade failure when stale data propagates across multiple projections.

layer2.mapping: Maps fresh-news adjudication to GSI conformal prediction intervals by treating each confirmation/refutation as an independent calibration event.
layer2.telemetry: Number of conflicting source updates per player within a 24-hour window, serving as a volatility proxy.

primitives.name: Burrow Playability Indicator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Burrow will play (CONFIRMED, 2nd+ source).** Zac Taylor: "good to go" after full practice Friday (cincinnati.com 9/18; rotoballer/ESPN's Ben Baby 9/18).
primitives.assumptions: Plays iff listed active status matches full participation in final practice session.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Inconsistent injury reporting leading to sudden inactive status, causing market crashes.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSE state-transition logic where active roster flags trigger conditional execution paths for stack viability.
layer2.telemetry: Delta between pre-practice fantasy ownership and post-practice price movements, indicating market reaction speed.

primitives.name: Flowers Doubtful Flag
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Flowers doubtful, not expected to play (CONFIRMED, official).** baltimoreravens.com 9/18: DNP Wed/Thu, limited Fri, DOUBTFUL; Jeff Zrebiec (Athletic) reports he's not expected to be available.
primitives.assumptions: WR Flowers is absent from the game-day lineup due to injury classification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Missing key receiving option forces Lamar Jackson into a higher-risk passing profile under pressure.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI binary classification models predicting game-script shifts based on receiver availability.
layer2.telemetry: BAL offensive snap distribution changes, specifically increased running-back targets and Lamar scrambles.

primitives.name: McConkey 50/50 Uncertainty
primitives.verbatim_quote: **McConkey Q, genuinely 50/50 (REFINED).** Schefter 9/17: "unlikely." But: limited practice Friday, final tag QUESTIONABLE (chargerswire 9/18); FantasyPros model 44% to play (9/19).
primitives.assumptions: WR McConkey's participation follows a Bernoulli trial with estimated success probability 0.44.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Binary outcome (in or out) creates branching scenario trees for quarterback projection ensembles.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSE multi-stage decision trees where player status influences subsequent action probabilities.
layer2.telemetry: Chargers receiver-target allocation variance conditional on McConkey's active status, measured via Shannon entropy.
